paite: Huan sun nisat laitak a puanin kongkhak bul a Abraham atut lai in, Mamre a tosaw kiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak hi.
heading: Abraham Tapa Piak Ding Chiamna
english: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

paite: Abraham dak in a-en a, ngai in, akiang ah mi thum ana dingh uhi. Amuhtak in puanin kongkhak a kipan amaute tuak ding in ava tai a, lei lam ah akunsuk hi.
english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood opposite him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

paite: "Ka toupa na deihsakna ka tan theihleh hehpih in na sikha hon paikheng mahmah ke'n.
english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

paite: Tui tawmchik bek hon la uhenla, na khete uh sil unla, sing nuai ah khawl tadih un.
english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

paite: Tanghou tawmchik bek ka va la ding a, na lungtang uh halhsak un. Huai khit chiang in na pai zom zel na ding uh. Huai ding a na sikha kiang a hong pai na hi peuhmah ding uh," achi hi. Amau, "Na chih bang in va hih in," achi uhi.
english: I will get a morsel of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”

paite: Puanin sung a Sarah kiang ah Abraham ava lut pah a, "Tangbuang nel mahmah tehna thum bawl in, mek inla, tanghou pei in bawl in," achi hi.
english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

paite: 7 Ganhon lam ah Abraham atai a, bawngnou hoihtak ava man a, asikha kiang ah apia a, ama'n abawl mengmeng hi.
english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

paite: Nawituidat, nawitui leh bawngnou sa kibawl ala a, ama uah ava luita hi. Amau anek sung teng uh, sing nuai ah akiang uah adingh nilouh hi.
english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na zi Sarah koi a om ahia?" achi ua, "Ama'n pam a puanin ah," achi hi.
english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “See, in the tent.”

paite: Amaute'n, "Hun ahong chin nawn peuhpeuh chiang in na kiang ah ka hong nawn ngeingei ding uh. Ngai in, na zi Sarah in tapa anei ding," achi hi. Anung a puanin kongkhak bul a kipan Sarah in ana za hi.
english: He said, “I will certainly return to you when the season comes round. Behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

paite: Abraham leh Sarah upapi, tektak ahita ua; numei dan ngeina Sarah ah akam khin thamta hi.
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

paite: Sarah in tektak ka hih nung in nopsakna ka nei thei lai diam maw, ka toupa lah a-upata ngal a? chi in alungsim in anui hi.
english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

paite: TOUPA'N Abraham kiang ah, "Bang achia Sarah in, kei pitek in ta ka nei thei lai diam maw, chi a nui ahia?
english: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child, yet I am old?’

paite: TOUPA a ding in thil himhim haksa lua a-om a hia? Hun seh ahong tun chiang in, na kiang ah ka hong nawn ding a, Sarah in tapa anei ding," achi hi.
english: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have a son.”

paite: Sarah in alauh ziak in, "Ka nui kei," chi in anial hi. Ama'n, "Zuau ahi, na nui tawk ve," achi hi.
english: Then Sarah denied, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

paite: Huai a kipan mite adingh ua, Sodom kholam a-en ua, amaute khakhe ding in akiang uah Abraham apai hi.
heading: Sodom A Ding In Abraham Athum
english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Ka thilhih ding Abraham ka iim diam aw;
english: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

paite: Abraham lah chi thupi leh thilhihtheitak ahong hi ngei ding a, amah ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl a om ding ahihdante?
english: since Abraham has surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

paite: Anung a atate leh a-inkuanpihte'n diktatna leh thudik a TOUPA lampi zui a, vaihawmna ding thu apiaktheihna ding in amah ka septa a; huchi a atungthu genpa TOUPA'N Abraham tung a atunsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

paite: TOUPA'N, “Sodom leh Gomorrah kalh a kikou thawmging anasa a, agitlouh mahmah ziak un.
english: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

paite: Tu in ka hohsuk ding a, akikou ging uh ka kiang a hong tung bangbang in ahih uhia, hih lou, ka en ding a, ahih kei uleh ka thei mai ding," achi hi.
english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

paite: Huai a kipan mite akihei ua, Sodom kholam azuanta uhi. Abraham bel TOUPA ma ah adingh lai hi.
english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.

paite: Abraham in ava naih a, “Mikhialte lak a midiktatte hihmangkhawm tel ding na hi maw?
english: Abraham drew near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

paite: Khosung ah midiktat sawmnga bek a-om kha ding uh e. Asung a midiktat sawmnga omte ziak in akhua hawi lou in na hihmang ding maw?
english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

paite: Nang hial in zaw migiloute bang a midiktatte a-om samna ding ua migiloute lak a midiktatte hihlup zaw na hih tel kei ding hi. Leitung pumpi Vaihawmpa in diktattak in ahih kei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Be it far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

paite: TOUPA'N, “Sodom a midiktat sawmnga ka muhleh amau ziak in akho pumpi ka hawi ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sake.”

paite: Abraham in, "Ngai in, kei leivui leh meivu lel in Toupa ka hon houpih thei hi.
english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, who am but dust and ashes.

paite: Midiktat nga in sawmnga chingzou lou ahi kha ding e; nga achin louh ziak in kho pumpi na hihmang ding maw? chi in adawng hi. Ama'n sawmli-le-nga ka muhleh ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it, if I find forty-five there.”

paite: Ama'n amah ahoupih zel a, "Huai ah sawmli kia na mu ahi kha ding e," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawmli ziak in leng ka hihmang dah mai ding," achi hi.
english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa aw, heh ke'n, ka hon gen nawn lai ding. Huai ah sawmthum lel na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Huai a sawmthum leng ka muhleh ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it, if I find thirty there.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ngai in, Toupa ka hon houpih theita a, huai ah sawmnih kia na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawmnih ziak in leng ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa aw, heh ke'n, khatvei kia ka hon gen lai ding. Huai ah sawm kia na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawm ziak in leng ka hihmang kei ding,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”

paite: Abraham toh akihou khit un TOUPA apaita a; Abraham leng amun ah akik nawnta hi.
english: Yahweh went his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
